She is a member of and the head of [[House Silva]], most members of House Silva and those affiliated with them refer to her as Domina Julia Silva. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Trivia== * The word "domina" is of Latin origin and typically refers to a woman of rank, such as a lady or mistress of a household. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Julia |1_zhs = 尤利娅 |1_zht = 尤利婭 |1_ja = ユリア |1_ko = 줄리아 |1_es = Julia |1_fr = Julia |1_de = Julia |2_en = Domina Julia Silva |2_zhs = 尤利娅・西尔瓦女士 |2_zht = 尤利婭・西爾瓦女士 |2_ja = ユリア・シルヴァ様 |2_ko = 줄리아 ・ 실바 |2_es = Dómina Julia Silva |2_fr = Dame Julia Silva |2_de = Matriarchin Julia Silva }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.4}}
